description:
Live like a local in the heart of Nashville's vibrant Nations neighborhood! Our stylish 3-story townhome offers the ultimate city experience. Start your day with coffee on the rooftop deck, admiring city views, then take a stroll to nearby hot spots. We're just a short walk to local gems like 51st Taproom, Southern Grist Brewing, and Frothy Monkey. Inside, you'll find an insta-worthy flower mural, chic decor, and plenty of space to make memories.

The space
Freshly upgraded just in time for Spring! Our home is packed with Nashville inspired artsy features including murals, a living/hangout room with a 80 Inch Smart TV, and an outdoor private deck! All while being comfortable and clean, this spot is the place to be for your Nashville getaway! Two living room and hangout spots!
